aboutText: Based in Preston, Carfi Cabinets specialises in the manufacturing and assembly of premium cabinetry for homes and businesses across Melbourne's northern suburbs. Our modern workshop combines state-of-the-art CNC machinery with traditional woodworking techniques to deliver precision-crafted solutions. With years of experience in the industry, we take pride in every piece that leaves our Beecher Street workshop.
servicesSubheading: Tailored to your space and style
servicesText: From custom kitchen cabinetry to commercial shopfitting, we design and manufacture quality pieces in our Preston workshop. Every project receives the same attention to detail and commitment to excellence.
